title: Shortest Bridge
constraints: grid is n × n, with 2 <= n <= 100
inputFormat: Implement shortestBridge(grid). Inputs below show JavaScript function arguments; there is no stdin parsing.
outputFormat: Return the minimum number of water cells (0s) to flip to connect the two islands using horizontal or vertical adjacency.

visuals.title: A bridge needs three water cells
visuals.caption: For opposite corners of a 3 × 3 grid, one shortest route flips the three outlined water cells. The two existing land cells are not counted.
